title: The two digits of a two-digit number
keyIdea: In a two-digit number the left digit counts tens and the right digit counts ones — so 47 means 4 tens + 7 ones (forty-seven), not 4+7 and not 7 tens.
familyTip: Point at 47 on a door or bus. Ask: how many tens rods? How many ones? Build it with sticks of ten and loose cubes.

visual.caption: Place-value idea or mix-up? Drag each clue, or tap it then a box.

items: the tens digit is worth that many tens

lab.caption: Flagship lab: build 35 on a tens/ones chart, expand 47, name the tens digit’s worth, expand a teen, catch digit-sum myth, build 52.

kid: A two-digit number has a tens place and an ones place.
The left digit tells how many tens. The right digit tells how many ones.
47 means 4 tens and 7 ones — forty-seven — not 4 plus 7.
A teen like 14 still follows the rule: 1 ten and 4 ones.
adult: CCSS 1.NBT.2: understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones; 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones; teens are 1 ten + some ones; decades are that many tens and 0 ones. Distinct from A Ten Is Ten Ones (bundling action) and A Hundred Is Ten Tens.
Words: tens, ones, place value, expand, digit. Common mistakes: adding the digits (47 as 11); reversing places (47 as 74’s places); reading the tens digit as that many ones.
In the lab your child builds 35 on a place chart, expands 47, names what the tens digit is worth, expands 14, spots the digit-sum mix-up, and builds 52.

practice.hint: Tens are worth ten each. Do not add the digits as ones.
practice.explain: 3×10 + 5 = 35. Adding digits to 8 or reversing to 53 are mix-ups.

practice.hint: Left digit = tens; right digit = ones.
practice.explain: 47 = 4 tens + 7 ones. Do not sum or reverse the digits.

practice.hint: Which place is the 2 sitting in?
practice.explain: The 2 is in the tens place, so it means two tens — twenty.

practice.hint: Each ten is worth 10. Multiply tens by 10, then add ones.

pool.explain: 60 = 6 tens + 0 ones — a decade with empty ones.

pool.explain: Digits name place values; summing them as ones is the mix-up.

Ones sit on the right of a two-digit number.
pool.explain: In 56 the ones digit is 6; the tens digit is 5.
